title: Multiweb
text: multiweb package provides tools analyzing comparing ecological networks, particularly food webs multiplex networks, set reproducible customizable functions. allows computation structural dynamic properties, module detection, species roles, trophic positions, entropy- centrality-based metrics, structural stability thresholds, extinction simulations. Multiplex (multilayer) networks supported throughout, including aggregation, interactive visualization, 3D layer rendering. vignette introduces general structure package showcases typical usage patterns.

title: Multiweb
text: multiweb package works individual network many functions accept lists network objects, network typically food web represented directed graph. preferred format list igraph objects, node species directed edges represent trophic links.
code: data("netData")  # A list of food web networks included in the package net <- netData[[23]] plot_troph_level_ggplot(net)

text: package includes tools generating null models maintaining degree distribution (Curve ball algorithm):  using niche model generate random networks size connectance:  can use null models assess significance observed metrics.
code: rand_net <- curve_ball(net) rand_metrics <- calc_modularity(rand_net, cluster_function = cluster_walktrap)  # Example: show distribution of connectance (C) and empirical value library(ggplot2) empirical_m <- calc_modularity(net, cluster_function = cluster_walktrap)$Modularity ggplot(rand_metrics, aes(x = Modularity)) +   geom_density(fill = "grey", color = "black") +   geom_vline(xintercept = empirical_m, color = "salmon", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +   theme_bw() +   labs(title = "Distribution of Modularity in Randomized Networks",        x = "Modularity") S <- metrics_all[23,"Size"] C <- metrics_all[23,"Connectance"] rand_net <- generate_niche(S,C,nsim=1000) rand_metrics <- calc_modularity(rand_net, cluster_function = cluster_walktrap)  # Example: show distribution of connectance (C) and empirical value library(ggplot2) empirical_m <- calc_modularity(net, cluster_function = cluster_walktrap)$Modularity ggplot(rand_metrics, aes(x = Modularity)) +   geom_density(fill = "grey", color = "black") +   geom_vline(xintercept = empirical_m, color = "salmon", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +   theme_bw() +   labs(title = "Distribution of Modularity in Randomized Networks",        x = "Modularity")

title: Multiweb
text: package also supports multiplex networks, multiple types interactions represented layers. can create multiplex object compute metrics across layers. can compute metrics like modularity entire multiplex structure, case using interface info_map algorithm.  Layers sharing node set can combined single aggregate network — summing edge weights interactions coincide across layers — useful common backbone layout approximation overall interaction load. harmonize_node_sets() first ensures every layer shares set nodes (adding isolated nodes needed) aggregating: 3D view layers stacked together, plot_multi3D() (adapted muxViz project) renders layer semi-transparent plane using rgl, optionally aggregate layer top. opens interactive OpenGL device, best explored active R session rather rendered :
code: fpath <- system.file("extdata", package = "multiweb") dn <- list.files(fpath,pattern = "^Kefi2015.*\\.txt$") mnet <- readMultiplex(dn,c("Negative","Positive","Antagonistic"),fpath,skipColum=2) mod_multi <- run_infomap_multi(mnet) head(mod_multi$communities) #>   module                   node layer        flow #> 1      6     acanthocyclus gayi     1 0.002427980 #> 2      6 acanthocyclus hassleri     1 0.002413950 #> 3      7       chiton  granosus     1 0.000546136 #> 4      7    fissurella  costata     1 0.000000000 #> 5      7     fissurella  crassa     1 0.000615915 #> 6      7    fissurella  limbata     1 0.000000000  plots <- plot_multiplex_modules(mnet, mod_multi$communities) cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 3) mnet_named <- mnet names(mnet_named) <- c("Negative", "Positive", "Trophic") mnet_named <- harmonize_node_sets(mnet_named) agg_net <- aggregate_multiplex_network(mnet_named) agg_net #> IGRAPH d84cd32 DNW- 106 4554 --  #> + attr: name (v/c), weight (e/n) #> + edges from d84cd32 (vertex names): #>  [1] acanthina monodon ->concholepas concholepas             #>  [2] acanthina monodon ->corallina offcinalis var. chilensis #>  [3] acanthina monodon ->gelidium spp.                       #>  [4] acanthina monodon ->gulls                               #>  [5] acanthina monodon ->heliaster helianthus                #>  [6] acanthina monodon ->perumytilus purpuratus              #>  [7] acanthina monodon ->semimytilus algosus                 #>  [8] acanthocyclus gayi->acanthocyclus gayi                  #> + ... omitted several edges plot_multi3D(   g.list = mnet_named,   layer.colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Set2"),   node.colors = "auto",   node.size.scale = 0.5,   show.aggregate = TRUE )

title: Multiweb
text: Real food webs must dynamically stable, requires minimal level intraspecific self-regulation (self-damping). true amount self-regulation rarely known, calc_stability_threshold() searches selfDamping value target proportion simulated community matrices (Jacobians) become unstable — default, 5% negative-eigenvalue crossings — using [calc_QSS()] internally. Lower (negative) thresholds indicate networks require less self-regulation remain stable: search trajectory can visualized directly:
code: stab <- calc_stability_threshold(net, nsim = 200, ncores = 1, verbose = FALSE) stab$threshold #> [1] -9.1 plot_stability_curve(stab)

what: Classify and plot topological roles — classify_topological_roles
title: Classify and plot topological roles — classify_topological_roles
text: function classifies species four topological roles based within-module degree (dz) among-module connectivity (PC), following approach Kortsch (2015). classification follows: modhub: Species high within-module degree (dz >= 2.5) low among-module connectivity (PC < 0.625). hubcon: Species high within-module degree (dz >= 2.5) high among-module connectivity (PC >= 0.625). modspe: Species low within-module degree (dz < 2.5) low among-module connectivity (PC < 0.625). modcon: Species low within-module degree (dz < 2.5) high among-module connectivity (PC >= 0.625).

text: g igraph object representing ecological network. vertexSizeMin Minimum node size (default: 8). vertexSizeMax Maximum node size (default: 25). modules Logical; TRUE, nodes grouped community modules along x-axis (default: FALSE). weights Edge weights used community detection modules = TRUE community_obj supplied (default: NA). community_obj Optional pre-computed community detection object (e.g. cluster_spinglass()). NULL modules = TRUE, community detection run internally via cluster_spinglass(). node_weights Optional numeric vector used size nodes. NA (default), node degree used. module_spacing Horizontal spacing multiplier community modules modules = TRUE (default: 350). modules = FALSE, node x-coordinates instead spread across wide random range scaled module_spacing * 1.5. physics Layout mode, one "x" "full" (default: "x"). "x": simulation, nodes can move horizontally vertical position stays fixed trophic level, layout settles trophic bands. "full": nodes move freely x y force-directed layout (forceAtlas2Based), anchored small centralGravity prevent unbounded drift. modes, stabilization finishes, physics disabled every node's fixed.x/fixed.y unlocked, trophic-level ordering ("x") force-directed layout ("full") just starting point — afterwards node can freely dragged direction. highlight Logical; TRUE, hovering node highlights nearest neighbors (default: TRUE). search Logical; TRUE, adds node-search dropdown widget (default: TRUE). label_size Font size, pixels, used node labels (default: 16). Apparent label size can differ physics modes even value, since "full" typically stabilizes spread-layout zoomed fit view; adjust parameter labels look large small given mode. width Width visNetwork widget, passed visNetwork::visNetwork() (default: "100%"). Accepts CSS width string (e.g. "600px", "100%"). height Height visNetwork widget, passed visNetwork::visNetwork() (default: "850px"). Accepts CSS height string. embedding slide frameworks like xaringan, set explicit pixel height small enough fit slide (e.g. "400px") — widget shrink fit container automatically.

text: Extends plot_troph_level_visNet() multiplex ecological networks, species interact several distinct types interactions (e.g. trophic vs. non-trophic: facilitation, competition, commensalism, amensalism) represented separate "layers" sharing set nodes. Trophic level computed using trophic layer, layers drawn together distinguishable edge colors/styles interactive layer filter.

text: g Either () single igraph object edge attribute (named layer_attr) identifying interaction type edge, (b) named list igraph objects, one per layer, sharing (subset ) vertex set via V(g)$name. List names used layer labels. layer_attr Name edge attribute holding layer/interaction-type label, used g single igraph object (default: "layer"). trophic_layer Value identifying layer represents trophic (feeding) interactions; used compute trophic level via NetIndices::TrophInd() (default: "trophic"). Species trophic-layer edges (e.g. species participate non-trophic interactions) assigned trophic level = 1 display purposes, warning. vertexSizeMin, vertexSizeMax Minimum/maximum node size (defaults: 8, 25). modules Logical; TRUE, nodes grouped community modules along x-axis, detected flattened (-layers-pooled) network (default: FALSE). weights Edge weights used community detection modules = TRUE community_obj supplied (default: NA). community_obj Optional pre-computed community detection object. node_weights Optional numeric vector used size nodes. title: Run Infomap on Multilayer Networks with Intralayer Links — run_infomap_multi
text: network weight attribute, used weight edges. Since exported multilayer network structure assumes *Intra links (.e., explicit inter-layer links), Infomap internally constructs inter-layer connections physical node using --multilayer-relax-rate parameter (default: 0.15). creates inter-layer links instances node across layers. weights links proportional weighted -degree node target layer, resulting non-uniform inter-layer transition probabilities. implicit construction inter-layer links enables Infomap model node-aligned multiplex dynamics without requiring explicit *Inter section input file.

Fixed curve_ball(): loop (rep 1:5*l_hp) evaluated (1:5)*l_hp, 5 trades attempted randomized networks kept ~93-98% links original network.
